prompt.zh: 320i 的引擎裝在車子的哪裡、怎麼放？
prompt.en: Where and how is the 320i engine mounted?

options.zh: 前面，直列四缸縱向擺放
options.en: At the front, inline-four mounted lengthways

explain.zh: BMW 傳統：引擎縱向放在前面，動力經變速箱、傳動軸送到後輪。
explain.en: BMW tradition: a lengthways front engine driving the rear wheels through the gearbox and propshaft.

prompt.zh: 3D 畫面亮起來的是哪個零件？
prompt.en: Which part is highlighted in the 3D view?

explain.zh: 最前面、最大片、後面有風扇的就是水箱。
explain.en: The biggest panel at the very front with a fan behind it is the radiator.

prompt.zh: 320i 是哪一種驅動方式？
prompt.en: Which wheels does the 320i drive?

explain.zh: 所以車底有一根長長的傳動軸和一顆後差速器。
explain.en: That is why there is a long propshaft and a rear differential under the floor.

prompt.zh: 亮起來的這個零件裝在哪裡？
prompt.en: Where is the highlighted part fitted?

explain.zh: BMW 把電瓶放後面，一來配重、二來遠離引擎熱。
explain.en: BMW puts the battery at the back for weight balance and to keep it away from engine heat.

prompt.zh: 動力從引擎到後輪經過的順序？
prompt.en: Put the power path from engine to rear wheels in order

explain.zh: 曲軸 → 變速箱 → 傳動軸 → 差速器 → 半軸 → 輪子。
explain.en: Crank → gearbox → propshaft → differential → half-shafts → wheels.

prompt.zh: 亮起來的是哪個零件？
prompt.en: Which part is highlighted?

explain.zh: 渦輪鎖在缸頭排氣側，用排氣推動葉輪壓縮進氣。
explain.en: The turbo bolts to the exhaust side of the head and uses exhaust gas to compress the intake air.

prompt.zh: N20 的水泵是用什麼驅動的？
prompt.en: What drives the N20 water pump?

explain.zh: N20 用電子水泵，引擎熄火後還能繼續循環幫渦輪降溫。
explain.en: The N20 has an electric pump that can keep circulating after shutdown to cool the turbo.

prompt.zh: 亮起來的是哪個零件？
prompt.en: Which part is highlighted?

explain.zh: 後軸中間那顆殼，把傳動軸的轉動分給左右半軸。
explain.en: The housing in the middle of the rear axle that splits drive to the two half-shafts.

prompt.zh: 踩下離合器踏板時，實際上發生什麼事？
prompt.en: What actually happens when you press the clutch pedal?

options.zh: 分離軸承推膜片彈簧，壓板退開，離合器片不再被夾住
options.en: The release bearing pushes the diaphragm spring, the pressure plate backs off and the disc is no longer clamped

options.zh: 離合器片被更用力壓在飛輪上
options.en: The disc is pressed harder onto the flywheel

explain.zh: 踩踏板 = 分離；放踏板 = 彈簧把離合器片夾回去。
explain.en: Pedal down = disengaged; pedal up = the spring clamps the disc again.

prompt.zh: 自排車的扭力變換器在什麼時候「鎖定」？
prompt.en: When does an automatic's torque converter lock up?

options.zh: 巡航時，鎖定離合器把泵輪和渦輪鎖在一起，不再打滑
options.en: When cruising: the lock-up clutch ties pump and turbine together so there is no slip

explain.zh: 起步靠油打滑放大扭力，巡航時鎖定省油。
explain.en: Pulling away uses fluid slip to multiply torque; cruising locks up to save fuel.

prompt.zh: 手排換檔時同步器的動作順序？
prompt.en: Put the synchroniser's actions in order when shifting

options.zh: 套筒推同步環摩擦齒輪錐面
options.en: The sleeve pushes the ring against the gear cone

options.zh: 套筒的犬齒滑進齒輪的齒
options.en: The sleeve's dogs slide into the gear teeth

explain.zh: 先摩擦同步、再咬合，所以叫「同步器」。
explain.en: Friction first to match speeds, then lock, hence "synchroniser".

prompt.zh: 為什麼拆凸輪軸前一定要先鎖正時工具？
prompt.en: Why must the timing lock go on before the camshafts come out?

options.zh: 氣門彈簧會把凸輪軸推轉，正時跑掉，裝回去氣門可能撞活塞
options.en: Valve springs rotate the cam, timing is lost and valves can hit pistons on refit
The bolts will not come undone otherwise

explain.zh: 這是 N20 最經典的致命錯誤之一，模擬器的錯誤示範會讓你看到後果。
explain.en: One of the classic fatal N20 mistakes; the simulator's mistake mode shows the consequence.

prompt.zh: 換前來令片的正確順序？
prompt.en: Put the front pad change in the right order

options.en: Push the piston back and fit new pads
Pump the pedal firm before driving

explain.zh: 最後一步最常被忘記，而且最危險。
explain.en: The last step is the one most often forgotten, and the most dangerous.

prompt.zh: 火星塞「用手鎖到底再接扭力扳手」是為了？
prompt.en: Why run spark plugs in by hand before the torque wrench?

options.zh: 歪牙時馬上感覺得到，不會把鋁缸頭的牙鎖壞
options.en: You feel cross-threading at once, before the aluminium threads are damaged

options.zh: 扭力扳手不能轉很多圈
options.en: Torque wrenches cannot turn many revolutions

explain.zh: 鋁缸頭的牙拉壞了，修理費比火星塞貴幾十倍。
explain.en: Stripped head threads cost many times more than the plugs.

prompt.zh: BMW 換完電瓶為什麼要「註冊」？
prompt.en: Why register a new battery on a BMW?

options.zh: 讓電腦重設充電策略，否則新電瓶會被當舊電瓶充，壽命縮短
options.en: So the charging strategy resets; otherwise the new battery is charged like an old one and ages early
The car will not start otherwise
It is only for warranty records

explain.zh: 智慧電瓶感知器（IBS）會依電瓶年齡調整充電，所以要告訴它換新了。
explain.en: The IBS adjusts charging by battery age, so it has to be told the battery is new.

prompt.zh: 拆變速箱之前，哪一樣一定要先下來？
prompt.en: Which must come off before the gearbox?

explain.zh: 傳動軸鎖在變速箱尾端，排氣中段又擋在傳動軸下面。
explain.en: The propshaft bolts to the back of the gearbox, and the mid pipe runs under the propshaft.

prompt.zh: N20 冷車起動幾秒內有「咔咔」聲，最可能是？
prompt.en: An N20 rattles for a few seconds on a cold start. Most likely cause?

options.zh: 正時鏈張緊器或塑膠導軌磨損
options.en: Timing chain tensioner or plastic guide wear

explain.zh: N20 早期塑膠導軌會碎，這是社群最常見的大故障。
explain.en: Early N20 plastic guides break up; it is the community's most reported major failure.

prompt.zh: 起步或收油時車底「咚」一聲，先檢查？
prompt.en: A clunk under the floor on take-off or lift-off: check first?

options.zh: 傳動軸撓性盤與中心軸承
options.en: Propshaft flex disc and centre bearing

explain.zh: 撓性盤龜裂、中心軸承橡膠塌陷都會讓傳動軸有空隙。
explain.en: A cracked flex disc or collapsed centre bearing gives the propshaft play.

prompt.zh: 高速煞車時方向盤抖，但平常不抖，先懷疑？
prompt.en: The wheel shakes under high-speed braking only. First suspect?

options.zh: 前碟盤厚薄不均或拉桿液壓襯套老化
options.en: Front disc thickness variation or worn tension-strut hydro bushes

explain.zh: 只有煞車時抖 = 跟煞車或承受煞車力的臂有關。
explain.en: Shake only under braking points at the brakes or the arms that take braking loads.

prompt.zh: 單缸失火、故障碼指向第 3 缸，最便宜的第一步？
prompt.en: A single-cylinder misfire on cylinder 3. Cheapest first step?

options.zh: 把 3 缸考爾和別缸對調，看故障碼跟不跟著走
options.en: Swap the cylinder-3 coil with another and see if the code follows

explain.zh: 對調零件是診斷的基本功：故障跟著零件走，就是那個零件壞。
explain.en: Swapping parts is basic diagnosis: if the fault follows the part, that part is bad.
